mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering corporate earnings concerns and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1% from 3-month highs signal broad demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% from 3-month highs.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production signals imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO growth (yoy) < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent price pressures, prompting Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.0% qoq) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth (qoq) > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase (>0.2pp) and payroll growth decline (>0.5%) signal labor market weakening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises >0.2pp and PAYEMS growth falls >0.5% from previous month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising >0.2pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), higher discount rates and risk aversion drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in monetary tightening cycles are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
